Marissa — thanks for the packet. Quick thoughts:

1) Approve +2 HC for Q3, provided we keep one slot tagged as "backfill/level-forced" (we should reserve flexibility to hire L5 vs L6 depending on candidate quality).
2) Comp bands: agree generally, but recommend upping the senior target OTE ceiling to $290k for high-impact hires given market inferences from recent offers in our peer set. We should reserve sign-off authority: hiring manager up to midpoint, exec approval for anything above midpoint to ceiling.
3) Please add an explicit fallback: if candidate requires >$290k, route to exec review and consider marking as "critical hire".

Cc'ing Tessa for offer execution timeline. I can greenlight the packet once Lauren validates budget impact.
